state_regulator.authority: MSP/CVED issues intrastate for-hire authority; household-goods carriers renew annually and purchase decals
state_regulator.insurance: General requirements include Certificate of Liability and Form E; household-goods carriers additionally file Form H
state_regulator.tariff: Tariff Membership required for travel over 40 miles without a continuous contract
state_regulator.continuous_contract: Copy of any continuous contracts, if applicable

carrier_search.request: One ordinary public search through POST /Home/GetCarrierList using the page's verification token and authorityType=Household Goods, currentAuthorityStatus=Active
